explication: Folia is a cross-platform music player centered on immersive lyric playback. The main user path is to search or browse music, select a track, play it from an online provider or local library, and view synchronized lyrics and visual themes. Local-library matching, Now Playing stage input, AI themes, and Folium mods are distinct capabilities. The graph combines README-documented product flows with relationships visible in the supplied excerpts; unsampled subsystems are represented without asserting unverified internal calls.
